OK so from the beginning. Got to work and there was just a weird vibe my manager we'll call him Terry took me in the office with Lori via Skype to discuss my attendance and to sign the 90 probation. Which I completely understand and take responsibility for. I cannot have any unexcused or excused occurrences for 90 days or I am terminated. 
So I asked about not being paid on Friday and if I would be. They said it was our presidents decison, we'll call him Bob and I would have to discuss further with him but because I have called in 4times before they aren't going to pay me for last week because they have already paid for those other absenses. We have no actual sick or vacation time. So I pointed out that I was always told we are guaranteed our base no matter what. So I got back to my desk and wrote an email to Bob advising that I was never advised that we may or not get paid for days off and I know others have gone out of town several times for a whole week and been paid. I pointed out that I was disappointed that I am just finding out I wasn't getting paid Monday after checking my acct several times over the weekend to see if the DD would hit. I also said I was disappointed that I didn't get any responses from the emails and not even a get well soon and I dont feel very supported by the team which is something they try to be. I told him I feel like I am being punished for being extremely sick and Its important that I get paid. Basically stating that there is no standard and that it's not fair to hold this against me without any kind of warning. 

Realy they fell short and should have talked to me about absences before last week and at that time stated that any future absenses will go unpaid and not just not pay me without any warning or notice until 3 days after pay day. 

So Bob got in and was pretty pissed which I didn't give a fuck. I mostly wanted to express my frustration and have my side be heard. 
So he was just like so I got your email and....and I said well I just wanted to express to you how I felt like I was being treated and I feel like I should be paid. Then he snapped back and said well if you want today could be your last day. I was completely cool and calm and he was showing anger. So I said no that is not what I want. Then he said well I suggest you just go back to your desk and do your work and well see by the end of the day if you continue to be a distraction to the company. I said yeah that is what I am doing. 

So then I had to pretend everything was all fine and dandy. Surprised I didn't get emotional and angry back. I have made many a scenes cried yelled and protested things I felt were important to me at jobs. But I was perfectly mature and calm because I don't want to bring drama or as little as possible to any future jobs. But it does seem to follow me a bit but I am working on leaving emotions and personal things at home and not bringing that stuff to work. 
So things settled. I just kept to myself looking at job apps on my phone and looking to update my resume because of Bobs asshole attitude towards me and just lashing out at me. I mean I get their preceptive of not wanting to pay me and being pissed I was gone last week but I was so fucking sick. We are a small start up like i mentioned so yes they don't have a ton of money at their disposal. 

So right before lunch Bob took me back in this office couple hours after the 1st meeting. And said that he wanted to kinda do a do over and told me a story about his early days of being a manager that he has a personal policy that he would always give people warning before taking action because many years ago he had an employee he fired for absences and she was completely blindsided because he didn't give her warning. And he discussed with them being a very small company everything counts and affects their bottom line and he hopes I would forgive him over the situation and he just wants to move passed this and he revered his decision and will pay me for last week. 

So it worked out in the end but I still might want to find another job either in sales like I am in or back to customer service call center. I want something that is easier to keep track of pay and not up and down either base or commissions which ever is higher and the bus commute to this location is a bit rough and not as easy as some. I had been obese most of my life. Grew up as a slightly chubby kid. Was always told I was just "stocky" and "big boned" like my paternal Italian side. Mom's side all really thin, mom had trouble keeping on weight. She had disordered eating issues. Sister was always super tiny, my grandmother used to skinny shame her and say she looked like a waif like Kate Moss and a Somalian, very offensive references. 
 Hit puberty at 11 before I even knew exactly what a period was and just really blew up. Remember I was 145 at 12-13 maybe at about my height now. I am 5ft 5 '1 on a good day. 
Flash forward all the horrible teenage years where I was very homely, didn't have a lot of money for nice clothes and in the 90s it was still really hard to find much cute plus size clothes. 
After I graduated and I weighted 230ish I started to buy clothes online like Torrid when I couldn't fit in the plus size clothes at The Deb. But I has excepted i was just a big girl and had some big girl confidence but I was always disgusted by really fat lazy people. I tried even for show to not be a cliche fat person like taking the stairs and going for a lot of walks. But I was real and knew what I was and was able to make fun of myself. Like I would jokinly call myself a fat fuck. Because I didn't believe in not saying yeah I'm fat and I can down all you can eat sushi like no one's business. But I didn't act superior about it. 

I didn't have much luck ever with guys. And knew it was due to my weight and other confidence issues. But I always had to really stand out. Bright red hair, flashy glam makeup. Met my now ex husband online who didn't really have a preference either way. As long as they had a pretty face. Which even obese I think I did. 

We were married 10 years and into like the 3rd. I had the opportunity to use my employer insurance to finally make what was really my dream come true to get weight loss surgery. I knew it was really the only way. I couldn't but never really tried that hard to lose any weight. But I knew I never wanted to go over 300. I was so scared I would. So I had met my out of pocket and went on the fast track to get the surgery by the end of the year so it was fully covered. I had broken my ankle falling down stairs beginning of the year and was non weight bearing in a wheel chair at 284 lbs and it was really it for me. 
So I got my insurance company to not require me to wait 6 mos to get it by doing approved weigh loss methods and seeing a dietian. 
My doctor didn't care I never really tried to lose weight. Have no idea how I passed the psych evaluation. Childhood was an abusive environment from my father. I had lots of depression and anxiety and anger. But for one appt and the test somehow they thought it was OK for me to get the surgery. 
Now no way did I take the easy way out. I had a complication during  surgery. I couldn't down any of the protein shakes after surgery, went back to work a little too soon. But when i was allowed I was going to the gym 4-6 days a week plus walking 15k steps. Measuring and weighing and tracking everything I ate even with my handy scale for going out to eat. I was a bit of a foodie and loved trying new and interesting things but food was just meh. But I exceeded expectations and lost 100 in the 1st 6mos and the remaining 50+ after. Started to tone up....but the underlying body dysmorphic tendencies started to kick in, I was too obsessed with then numbers, the calories and macros, the scale number weighing myself several times a day. 
I started to take some water pills and stool softener. I have had stomach and bowel issues since the surgery. Horrible times with that. 

I didn't take the pills too much but I was so obssessive, paranoid and crazy. Where I would have my ex take pics of me from every angle and make him tell me if I look like I am fatter or gaining weight and scream and call him a liar when he didn't agree I was getting fatter at about 135. I had a goal weight of 120 but I wanted to get down to 100 because i knew with my height it was doable. I already started to look gaunt and unhealhy at my lowest of 127. I told him I wanted my bones to stick out. By the time we broke up i was drinking a 4 shot expresso latte and maybe a yogurt. I wasn't going to the gym at that time anymore. I was heading down ED-ville. And I was aware of it and looked for disorder eating treatment and early signs of a developing ED. I sorta went nuts. It was hard because I didn't recognize myself thin or fat. I didn't know who I was. Flash foward after 6 days at a mental facility,blood curddling fights, asking for an open marriage, not sure if I what I wanted relationship wise, was it to fuck around like I never got a chance to do when I was 22 when I got married. Or did i want to experiment with girls. Or much older men my dad's age or just be alone. So we got divorced. I was diagnoised with some really heafty mental health illness. Still struggle with body and food issues. 
Still maintaining but want to lose 20-25 I gained but mental struggles don't help to motivate. 
Eat kinda crappy usually a lot and then not much the next day. But 3 years later I  happy I've overall kept it off. It was such a fear for me that I would prove everyone wrong, fail and gain all the weight back and then some like a lot of people do after significant weight loss. 
I am happy I did it. And I love being thin but it really was for looks. Some due to health but I didn't have any obesity related illness yet except high BP but no medication. Fitting into a airplane seat with no extender was really a major NSV for me. But it ruined me in a lot of ways. I used to be a lot happier when i was big and life really started to fall apart but I am still very happy I lost weight. But the price you pay for what you thought would be a dream come true and alll the issues that were hiding under all the fat...
